decisions.reason: After four years, a core handle line that has not been observed on the website for two years is likely judged against clearer internal and peer aspirations, and a large firm that already reallocated resources from other launches would probably prune it if it has not earned a durable place in the range.

As a single design variant close to many existing offers, its differentiation is limited, and the long period without website visibility suggests performance has likely fallen short of aspiration so resources are better shifted to stronger core lines or new development.

Like other standalone handle designs, it faces high pruning risk once initial uncertainty has passed, and the absence of continued market visibility indicates it probably did not justify retention relative to comparable products in the portfolio.

Although a broader family normally benefits from portfolio fit and organisational slack, by 2022 the firm would likely discontinue a line no longer visibly supported if its results remained below aspiration and redirect resources to more promising integrated system families.
